info.title: Dynode Gateway
info.description: Weather (OpenWeather) and Norway flights (Avinor) for players in Sweden, Norway, and Poland.

post.description: Invalidates the Sweden weather cache by bumping the internal cache version used in weather request cache keys.

get.description: Resolves coordinates from the Sweden player dataset (or latlon) and returns OpenWeather data.

parameters.name: latlon
parameters.description: The raw comma-separated coordinates (e.g., 32.46564,12.8737874). Optional when player is provided.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: A player ID resolved from the dataset. Optional when latlon is provided.

parameters.name: resource_id
parameters.description: An alias of player that resolves the same player ID from the dataset.

parameters.name: debug
parameters.description: Optional debug flag. When set to true, the response includes a debug object with the original upstream OpenWeather URL, with the appid value masked.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Optional response format. By default returns JavaScript as data = {...};. Use format=json to return raw JSON.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: When set to false, bypasses the default response field allowlist and returns the full upstream payload.

post.description: Invalidates the Norway flights cache by bumping the internal cache version used in flights request cache keys.

get.description: Returns Avinor flight data filtered by gate at a Norwegian airport. Two lookup modes: (1) direct — `gates` with optional `iata`, or `iata` alone for all gates at that airport; (2) player — `player` or `resource_id` resolved from the Norway dataset. Modes are mutually exclusive. Default direction is AD (arrivals and departures). Gates accepts a single code, comma-separated list, dot notation (e.g. C2.C3), or * for all gates.

parameters.name: gates
parameters.description: Direct lookup: airport gate(s) to filter flights (e.g. D9, C34,C35, or * for all gates). Use with optional `iata`. Mutually exclusive with player/resource_id. Legacy alias: `gate`.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: Player lookup: resolved to gate(s) and IATA from the Norway player dataset. Mutually exclusive with gates.

parameters.name: resource_id
parameters.description: Alias of player for player lookup. Mutually exclusive with gates.

parameters.name: iata
parameters.description: Direct lookup: IATA airport code (e.g. OSL, BGO). With `gates`, selects the airport (defaults to OSL when omitted). Without `gates`, returns all gates at this airport. Alias: airport.

parameters.name: airport
parameters.description: Alias of iata for compatibility.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Flight direction. A = arrivals, D = departures, AD = both. Defaults to AD.

parameters.name: debug
parameters.description: Optional debug flag. When set to true, the response includes a debug object with the upstream Avinor URL and related metadata.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Optional response format. By default returns JavaScript as data = {...};. Use format=json to return raw JSON.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: When set to false, bypasses the default response field allowlist and returns the full upstream payload.
